links.export_unit: One whole fixed panel, with two real production/checker stages as two rows. Internal cases retained. They share setup and a process; they are not independent timing trials.

question: What complete three-summand query sets and quotient ranks occur on the declared undisclosed-label secp256k1 signed orbit base, with identical symmetry in the baseline?

claims.text: The raw fixed-panel matrix/point certificates are checked against a separate implementation over the identical declared inputs.
No performance, generic success law, unknown-target logarithm recovery, novelty or official research transition is established by this panel.

arms.description: Affine group arithmetic and complete pair-table three-summand solver.
Independent projective full-multiset enumeration and separate modular-domain ranks.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic finite-domain certificates, no noisy/timed primary metric or performance comparison; the independent checker supplies a correctness reference.

positive.not_applicable_reason: A target constructed from representatives0,1,2 is an embedded internal query through the exact production and oracle solvers; known support must be detected. The historical96 constructed rows are separate regression controls.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Wrong beta, conjugate lambda branch and nonidentity false homogeneous row are embedded refusal controls. All eight ordinary targets are independently hashed without supplied supporting triples.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed complete panel then stop; do not choose new cases or seeds after results.
112-second signal guard,120-second external infrastructure watchdog and2GiB address-space limit; uncompleted work is unknown.

invalidation_rules: Failed certificates/controls are invalid observations for the affected conclusion, not mathematical nulls.
A timeout or partial row is not evidence of zero solutions.
No noisy wall/CPU value is a performance measurement.
No source, offsets, seeds or cases change after data without a prospective versioned amendment.

decision_rule.text: Report exact scoped outputs and any mismatch/control/unknown state. Equality verifies the stated implementation joint only; extraction completeness and detector qualification remain separate where stated.
decision_rule.threshold: Exact equality of checked certificates/query sets/ranks, with explicit positive/refusal outcomes.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact finite sets, determinants/norm certificates and modular ranks; no p-value.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Exact difference only; no comparative runtime or asymptotic effect.

graphs: Recorded exact internal case counts and scope diagram; no extrapolated runtime

inadmissible: Calling a prepared source an executed result.
Treating known-root/constructed positives as ordinary target recovery.
Counting pure symmetry rank as new representative-log information.
Reading a sufficient-bound failure as general impossibility.
A subroutine count or shared clock as end-to-end attack cost.

literature.claim: Actual sources read and their scope before implementation.
